prompt_verbatim: Based only on this recording, does this speaker show signs of dementia? Answer with one word, Yes or No.

source_paths_absolute.audio_source_mac: /Volumes/G-Drive Pro/DementiaBank/segments (468 wav, 516863704 bytes, byte-count verified equal on pod)
source_paths_absolute.manifest_built_from: /Users/chaitanyaparwatkar/Desktop/release/omni_final/omnisft_pitt_oof.csv (READ ONLY; used for path/speaker/label/set in the paper's own row order)
source_paths_absolute.arms_reference: /Volumes/G-Drive Pro/DementiaBank/pitt_conflict_manifest.csv (146 conflict + 322 agreement; arm labels carried in the manifest 'set' column, cross-checked to these counts)

folds.source: NO saved fold file exists anywhere under /Users/chaitanyaparwatkar/Desktop/release (searched by filename and by scanning every *_oof.csv header for a 'fold' column). Folds were therefore generated once by make_folds.py and SAVED to pitt468_folds.csv, then LOADED by the training script.
folds.method: sklearn GroupKFold(n_splits=5) grouped by speaker over the manifest's own row order -- the identical call used in sft_projector.py, the script that produced the paper's projector fine-tune

training.target_modules: q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj on all 28 thinker LM decoder layers (112 modules); audio_tower and projector frozen (asserted in code)
training.loss: cross entropy over the two logits [' Yes',' No'] at the final answer position -- copied verbatim from sft_projector.py

scoring.p_yes: softmax over the two logits [' Yes',' No'] at the first answer position -- matches the paper's projector run exactly, so the two are comparable
scoring.p_yes_multivariant: P(Yes-variants)/(P(Yes-variants)+P(No-variants)), summing single-token encodings of Yes/yes/YES and No/no/NO, bare and leading-space
scoring.answer_mass: P(Yes-variants)+P(No-variants) from the full-vocabulary softmax, recorded per clip
scoring.decoding: deterministic teacher-forced forward pass, no sampling

statistics.auc: Mann-Whitney rank formula with 0.5 credit for ties, recomputed from the per-clip csv; never read from any json
statistics.bootstrap: 2000 draws, numpy.random.default_rng(0) reseeded per cell, SPEAKERS resampled with replacement, percentile 2.5/97.5
statistics.arm_cells: speakers resampled within that arm's own speaker universe
statistics.paired_diff: one speaker list drawn per replicate, both arms recomputed inside that draw

verification.method: two independent implementations of the rank AUC and the bootstrap (stats.py: rank-array Mann-Whitney + per-draw index concatenation; verify_pitt.py: searchsorted U-statistic + index-matrix draws), same documented protocol and seed
verification.agreement: identical to 6 decimals on every cell reported here
verification.auc_implementation_check: validated against a brute-force O(n^2) pairwise Mann-Whitney with ties to 1e-12

command: python3 lora_pitt.py mf_pitt468_pod.csv pitt468_folds.csv lora_pitt Qwen/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B
